title: 统计作战单位数
summary: 从评分数组中选择 i<j<k，统计评分严格递增或严格递减的三人队伍数。
insight: 固定中间人 j，统计左侧更小与更大人数、右侧更小与更大人数；两类合法组合数直接相乘相加。
pitfalls: 评分互不相同且比较严格
每支队伍由唯一中间下标计数一次

solutions.title: 固定中间成员计数
solutions.idea: 枚举中点并组合左右两侧的大小关系。
steps: 对 middle 从零到 n-1
扫描左侧统计 lessLeft、greaterLeft，扫描右侧统计 lessRight、greaterRight

code.java: class Solution { public int numTeams(int[] rating){int answer=0;for(int middle=0;middle<rating.length;middle++){int lessLeft=0,greaterLeft=0,lessRight=0,greaterRight=0;for(int left=0;left<middle;left++)if(rating[left]<rating[middle])lessLeft++;else greaterLeft++;for(int right=middle+1;right<rating.length;right++)if(rating[right]<rating[middle])lessRight++;else greaterRight++;answer+=lessLeft*greaterRight+greaterLeft*lessRight;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun numTeams(rating:IntArray):Int{var answer=0;for(middle in rating.indices){var lessLeft=0;var greaterLeft=0;var lessRight=0;var greaterRight=0;for(left in 0 until middle)if(rating[left]<rating[middle])lessLeft++ else greaterLeft++;for(right in middle+1 until rating.size)if(rating[right]<rating[middle])lessRight++ else greaterRight++;answer+=lessLeft*greaterRight+greaterLeft*lessRight};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int numTeams(vector<int>& rating){int answer=0;for(int middle=0;middle<(int)rating.size();++middle){int lessLeft=0,greaterLeft=0,lessRight=0,greaterRight=0;for(int left=0;left<middle;++left)rating[left]<rating[middle]?++lessLeft:++greaterLeft;for(int right=middle+1;right<(int)rating.size();++right)rating[right]<rating[middle]?++lessRight:++greaterRight;answer+=lessLeft*greaterRight+greaterLeft*lessRight;}return answer;} };
